verdict.rationale: Only fragments of a security posture appear. One doc states that `--path` local project context stays local during retrieval. MCP auth uses scoped permissions such as `context:protected:read` behind an RFC 9728 OAuth wall. `init --dry-run` previews exactly which SKILL.md files will be written before anything changes. There is no consolidated security or trust document. missing for 10: a documented statement of what installed skills can execute, a trust model for third-party skills, a telemetry/data-collection disclosure, and independent corroboration.
